mapper.insert: INSERT INTO physician_entry (customer_id, physician_name, department_entry_id, department_name, code, notes, usage_count, is_active, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{customerId}, #{physicianName}, #{departmentEntryId}, #{departmentName}, #{code}, #{notes}, #{usageCount}, #{isActive}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE physician_entry SET physician_name = #{physicianName}, department_entry_id = #{departmentEntryId}, department_name = #{departmentName}, code = #{code}, notes = #{notes}, is_active = #{isActive}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM physician_entry WHERE customer_id = #{customerId} AND is_active = 1
